items.html:
(to the question) Torah
The Mochin of ZA are called by the name Torah. And this is in the secret of what our sages said: "the unripe fruits of the upper Hochma are Torah, and the unripe fruits of the upper Bina are the Shechina." The explanation: for fruits before the completion of their ripening are called unripe fruits. And it is known that the breaking of the vessels was because the vessels were small; but in the future, at the completion of the correction, after the vessels have grown in the world of correction, then BYA will return to be Atzilut, as it was before the breaking of the vessels, in the secret of "when the feet touch the feet," as is known. Hence the breaking was because the vessels received the great lights before they had grown all their need. And therefore this resembles unripe fruits. And it is known that the Achoraim of Aba, which were nullified at the time of the breaking of the vessels — from them come all the Mochin of ZA. Hence the unripe fruits of the upper Hochma, which are the nullified Achoraim of Aba — from them are drawn the Mochin of ZA, which are called Torah. And from the Achoraim of YESHSUT were made all the Mochin of the Nukva of ZA; and YESHSUT are Bina; hence the unripe fruits of the upper Bina are the Shechina. (Part 1, Page 131, Item 11).
